answer: Challenge tasks are cryptographically entangled with future unbiasable beacon pulses from a threshold-BLS network, so their unpredictable inputs cannot be precomputed or farmed offline by automated Sybil swarms. A commit-reveal protocol binds each claimant before the pulse, while post-reveal verification exposes equivocation. Thus, whether labeled sparrow, island, or juniper, an agent must sustain accountable, timely participation rather than multiply identities cheaply.
